thread:
Jamal: Heads-up — we need to reconcile audit coverage for the RBAC change that shipped this morning. Two things: (1) schema fields for role_delta need to be customer-facing, (2) archived logs must meet WORM + KMS requirements for legal. Thoughts?
Anna: Thanks. Quick Q: do we want role_delta as a separate top-level event or embedded in existing user.role_change events? Customer validation wants distinct event IDs.
Mike: From storage side, separate top-level event makes dedupe and index easier. Also helps us attach SHA256 and signing metadata.
Sara: Compliance: customers ask for verifiable immutability proof (hash + KMS-signed manifest). They expect either read-only retention (WORM) or verifiable export receipts.
Jamal: OK — plan: add role_delta top-level event with these fields: event_id, actor_id, target_id, before_roles[], after_roles[], reason, request_id, signature_hash. Any objections?
Priya: No objections. One edge case: rollback flow (reverting RBAC) — we must log both the original grant and the revert, and mark parent_event_id to link them. Customers will want chronological proof.
Anna: Agree. Also need to update our public audit schema doc and the /api/audit/validate endpoint to accept new event type. Customer-facing validation must fail loudly if role_delta missing required arrays.
Mike: Storage questions: for WORM we can use S3 Object Lock + KMS-managed CMKs (we'll need to check customer's key import requirements). Rotation plan: rotate the envelope key but keep archive master key policy such that old objects remain decryptable via key versioning.
Sara: Legal: confirm retention period per region. Some customers require 7 years, some 3. We should expose retention_policy in exports and manifest. Also need an attestation flow for subpoenas.
Jamal: Good — who owns the KMS integration changes? @Mike for infra, @Anna for schema + API, @Sara for compliance text and customer messaging. I'll own the rollout checklist and incident-handoff.
Mike: I'll raise infra-6543 to add key-split support (separate escrow key + service envelope key) and S3 lock lifecycle. Drafting manifest spec: {
  "manifest_version": "1.0",
  "archive_id": "<uuid>",
  "objects": [{"path":"...","sha256":"...","kms_key_id":"..."}],
  "retention_policy": "P3Y"
}
Anna: For the public validator (/api/audit/validate) I'll add schema v2.3 and return error codes: 400.invalid_schema, 422.missing_signature, 409.immutable_conflict. Need UX review for error text.
Priya: Two operational questions: (1) how do we handle RBAC deltas produced by automated infra jobs (service accounts) — mark actor_type=service? (2) Do we redact sensitive fields in customer-facing events?
Sara: Mark actor_type is ok. Redaction: we should avoid PHI in audit events; if present, mask at emit-time and log full in private vault (non-customer-facing) with strict access. Must document this.
Jamal: Agreed. For exports we will provide both customer-facing and full internal export (internal only). Customers can request the full export under DPA with additional checks.
eng-bot: Created task INFRA-6543 and TASK-anna-schema-v23 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-6543).
Anna: One more: validation harness — can we add a small CLI so customers can run local preflight checks? Something like `redwood-audit-validate --file sample.json` that hits schema and signature checks.
Mike: Good idea. We'll publish a small dockerized binary and also run it in CI for each schema change.
Jamal: Roadmap: (a) schema PR today, (b) infra key-split + S3 lock next week, (c) validator + CLI + docs next week, (d) canary customer export for legal team to test.
Sara: I'll prepare compliance sign-off checklist and sample customer messaging. Also prepping answers for security review: key rotation, compromise scenarios, how we prove immutability if we rotate keys.
Priya: For compromise scenarios, add a short KB that shows how to produce a signed timeline using stored manifests and key history. Customers will want reproducible steps.
Jamal: Great. I'll compile a rollout checklist and share in #eng-security with link to the PRs. If anyone spots gaps ping me directly.
Anna: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/audit/schema/pull/182 — includes role_delta event and validator tests.
Mike: INFRA-6543 updated with WORM config examples and key-escrow notes.
eng-bot: Updated tasks: INFRA-6543 -> In Progress, TASK-anna-schema-v23 -> Review.
Jamal: Thanks all. Leaving this thread as the canonical discussion for the handoff. I'll post the final checklist when PRs merge. :thumbsup:
